brief.headline: Post-holiday revenue and conversion fell sharply, with mobile and Canada underperforming the total.
executive_summary: Revenue was 10368 vs 14716 (-29.5%), transactions were 165 vs 257 (-35.8%), and conversion rate was 0.68 vs 1.06 (-36%).
Sessions were 20444 vs 22083 (-7.4%), so the revenue drop is not explained by traffic alone.
Mobile and Canada moved further below the total, while total AOV rose to 62.84 vs 57.26 (+9.7%).

what_changed.title: Total revenue and conversion fell after the holiday week
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 10368 vs 14716 (-29.5%), transactions were 165 vs 257 (-35.8%), and conversion rate was 0.68 vs 1.06 (-36%).

what_changed.title: Mobile monetization fell more than the total
what_changed.detail: Mobile revenue per session was 0.26 vs 0.59 (-55.4%, gap_vs_total_pts -31.5) and mobile AOV was 28.63 vs 44.85 (-36.2%, gap_vs_total_pts -45.9).

what_changed.title: Canada fell more than the total
what_changed.detail: Canada revenue per session was 0.29 vs 1.34 (-78.4%, gap_vs_total_pts -54.5) and Canada conversion rate was 0.51 vs 1.54 (-67.1%, gap_vs_total_pts -31.1).

what_changed.title: AOV rose while transactions fell
what_changed.detail: Total AOV was 62.84 vs 57.26 (+9.7%) and desktop AOV was 92.42 vs 68.74 (+34.4%, gap_vs_total_pts 24.7), while total transactions were 165 vs 257 (-35.8%).

what_changed.title: High-interest products had zero purchases
what_changed.detail: Android Iconic Crewneck Sweatshirt had views_cur 1366, adds_to_cart_cur 486, purchase_lines_cur 0, view_to_purchase_pct 0, and revenue_delta -616.

likely_drivers: The week followed Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, and Boxing Day, so the drop is likely a post-holiday demand reset.
New Year's Eve and New Year's Day may have reduced purchase intent, consistent with lower transactions and conversion.
Mobile and Canada gaps are consistent with a larger post-holiday reset in those segments, but the size of the gaps suggests segment-specific issues to verify.
The AOV increase is consistent with fewer, larger orders after the holiday peak.
risks: If mobile and Canada issues are not checked, the revenue decline may continue into the next week.
If high-interest products remain at zero purchases, product demand will not convert.
If source data is not treated with caution, channel decisions may be based on obfuscated or missing source values.
